_readme: DUSK AT THE HELM -- the storm sea off the north jetty tip, looking at where the sun went down.
Before d53bcc0 the waves still caught a sun two degrees under the horizon: a white glint and
green-lit faces under a sky whose own sun was gone. Now every surface asks the PLANET whether it
has a sun (PlanetShadow), and the water's mirror shows the twilight glow the air still has.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/merrimack_dusk.json
The sun is the light at 0,0,0 and the Earth is placed around it -- the Haulover demo's place,
turned further: the sun stands -2.04 deg here, azimuth 213.7. sun.earth.spin is a RESTART key;
edit it and relaunch to walk the sunset through the disc: 107.0777 = +1.50 deg (the sunset and
its glint), 111.33 = 0.00 (half the disc down, the glint at half), 112.08 = -0.27 (the last of
the disc gone), 116.5777 = -2.04 (dusk). The view is fixed at azimuth 213.7, so the sun stays in
frame for all of them. FLY: W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look.
